visualCharacteristics: Bordered card grid; styles solutions | productlines | insights | simple | features via Style select. Product Lines: light-grey band, white bordered cards in a 3-up grid on desktop, image on top, bold linked title, rich-text description below.

contentPattern.structure: image cell | rich-text cell (h4 title linked to the detail page, then description paragraphs; may include a sub-heading, bullet list and italic note). An optional first row without an image holds the heading/intro

reuseGuidance: Use for grids of look-alike linked cards (image, title, description). Pick the style option that matches the density.
